headline: Bench Singletary for Breece Hall before 5:15 PM Pacific tonight, and add a QB because Willis is on IR and Darnold is out.
alerts: By 5:15 PM Pacific tonight: move Devin Singletary to the bench and start Breece Hall. Cam Skattebo is active for the Giants.
Giants DEF stays in and locks at 5:15 PM Pacific tonight.
You have no healthy QB. Willis is on IR and Darnold is ruled out. Add one before Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific, and drop Seth McGowan or Germie Bernard to make room.
A.J. Brown and Amon-Ra St. Brown play in Munich Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. Check Friday injury reports. Hockenson did not practice Wednesday.
Sleeper could not be opened this run, so the roster here is last week's. Confirm in the app.

NYG.note: Hosts Washington Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific at MetLife. Giants -1.5, total 42.5, about 22 implied. Skattebo active, J.J. McCarthy full go.

WAS.note: At the Giants Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific. About 20.5 implied. C Lucas Patrick and TE Colson Yankoff are inactive.

MIA.note: At Indianapolis Sunday. Willis on IR, Kyle McCord starts.

SEA.note: At Las Vegas Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Darnold out, Drew Lock starts.

DET.note: Plays New England in Munich Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. St. Brown limited Wednesday.

NE.note: Plays Detroit in Munich Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. A.J. Brown limited Wednesday. Rhamondre Stevenson expected out.

MIN.note: At Green Bay Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Hockenson did not practice Wednesday.

NYJ.note: Hosts Buffalo Sunday. Garrett Wilson remains out.

IND.note: Hosts Miami Sunday. Jonathan Taylor full in practice.

PIT.note: At Cincinnati Sunday night 5:20 PM Pacific, game total about 49.5.
